This is the code base for the project. The input and intermediate files were queried
from databases or were outputs of analyses have been directly read into the code, however
steps to retrieve input data and reproduce results have been commented.

\

### 2. Setting Variables
```{r}
study <- "TCGA-BRCA"

# File paths
input_data_common_dir <- file.path(here(), "data_files")
input_data_study_dir <- file.path(here(), "data_files", study)
results_save_dir <- file.path(here(), "data_files", study)
plots_save_dir <- file.path(here(), "data_files", study, "plots")

# Data filters
expression_threshold <- 60

# Target genes
genome <- "hg38"
peak.distance.from.TSS <- 5
TF_targets_path <- file.path(input_data_common_dir, "TF_targets")
cell_lines_threshold <- NULL
gene_peaks_in_cell_lines_threshold <- 0.5
```

### 3. Data Preparation

\
We will only consider protein-coding transcripts from the `RNA` expression data.
\
```{r, warning=FALSE}
rna_data_protein_coding <- rna_data[which(rowData(rna_data)$gene_type == "protein_coding"),]

rna_analysis <- as.data.frame(rna_data_protein_coding@assays@data@listData$tpm_unstrand)
names(rna_analysis) <- rna_data_protein_coding$sample

row.names(rna_analysis) <-rowData(rna_data_protein_coding)@rownames

# Storing gene names from TCGA data here - because some gene IDs have the same gene symbol,
# duplicate row names cannot be assigned in the previous step
gene_mapping <- data.frame(gene_id = rowData(rna_data_protein_coding)@rownames,
                           gene_symbol = rowData(rna_data_protein_coding)$gene_name)
```

\
Cleaning miR data for further analysis - making the column name of `miRNA` 
expression the same as `RNA` expression.
\
```{r}
# select RPM of miRNA for corrolation analysis
miRNA_analysis <-  mirna_data %>%
              dplyr::select(miRNA_ID, contains("reads_per_million_miRNA_mapped"))

# rename rows (miRNA ID) and columns (patient ID)
rownames(miRNA_analysis) <- miRNA_analysis$miRNA_ID
colnames(miRNA_analysis) <- gsub("reads_per_million_miRNA_mapped_", "", colnames(miRNA_analysis))

# drop column miRNA_ID (this information is stored in row names)
miRNA_analysis <- miRNA_analysis %>% dplyr::select(-miRNA_ID)

# To make the miRNA column name match the sample ID
names(miRNA_analysis) <- gsub("-[^-]*$","",
                              # "-": match string with "-"
                              # "-[^-]*": match all non "-" strings followed by the "-"
                              # "$": match only at the last occurrence of the pattern
                              gsub("-[^-]*$","",
                                   # repeat three times to remove the strings after the 3rd last ""
                                   gsub("-[^-]*$","",names(miRNA_analysis))))
```


\
Right now, the data size is as follows:
\
```{r}
dim(rna_analysis)
dim(miRNA_analysis)
```

```{r}
common_cols <- intersect(names(rna_analysis), names(miRNA_analysis))

# Keep RNA samples with miRNA data
# rna_analysis <- rna_analysis[, names(miRNA_analysis)[which(names(miRNA_analysis) %in% names(rna_analysis))]]
rna_analysis <- rna_analysis[, common_cols, drop = FALSE]

# Match the samples of miRNA data with RNA data
miRNA_analysis <- miRNA_analysis[, common_cols, drop = FALSE]

cat(length(names(miRNA_analysis)), "samples have matched mRNA & miRNA data\n")

dim(rna_analysis)
```

#### 3.1 Removing genes with no expression
\
We first filter out `rNA` and `miRNA` with no expression, i.e., rows which have only 0's:
\

```{r}
miRNA_analysis <- miRNA_analysis %>%
  dplyr::filter(rowSums(.) > 0) # miRNAs with no expression across all samples, rowSums (sum of expression) = 0

rna_analysis <- rna_analysis %>%
  dplyr::filter(rowSums(.) > 0)
```
\
New data dimensions:
\
```{r}
dim(rna_analysis)
dim(miRNA_analysis)
```
\

#### 3.3 Removing low-expressed transcripts

```{r}
rna_analysis <- rna_analysis %>%
  mutate(ZeroPercentage = rowMeans(. == 0, na.rm = TRUE) * 100) %>%
  dplyr::filter(ZeroPercentage <= expression_threshold) %>%
  dplyr::select(-ZeroPercentage)

miRNA_analysis <- miRNA_analysis %>%
  mutate(ZeroPercentage = rowMeans(. == 0, na.rm = TRUE) * 100) %>%
  dplyr::filter(ZeroPercentage <= expression_threshold) %>%
  dplyr::select(-ZeroPercentage)


dim(rna_analysis)
dim(miRNA_analysis)
```


#### 3.4 Log transforming data 
\
Add 1 and take log2 of each value in both datasets:
\
```{r}
rna_analysis <- rna_analysis %>% mutate_all(~ log2(. + 1))
miRNA_analysis <- miRNA_analysis %>% mutate_all(~ log2(. + 1))
```

### 4. Analysis


#### 4.1 Correlation

```{r}
# combined.matrix <- t(as.matrix(rbind(rna_analysis, miRNA_analysis)))
# cor.res <- rcorr(combined.matrix)
# 
# saveRDS(cor.res, file.path(save_dir, "cor_res.RDS"))

cor.res <- readRDS(file.path(input_data_study_dir, "cor_res.RDS"))

# simplify the matrix - row is mRNA and column is miRNA
r_matrix <- cor.res$r[!grepl("hsa-", colnames(cor.res$r)),grepl("hsa-", colnames(cor.res$r))]
p_matrix <- cor.res$P[!grepl("hsa-", colnames(cor.res$P)),grepl("hsa-", colnames(cor.res$P))]
```

Merging the two dataframes:
\
```{r}
r_matrix <- as.data.frame(r_matrix) %>%
  mutate(RNA = rownames(r_matrix)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -RNA,
               names_to = "miRNA",
               values_to = "coef")

p_matrix <- as.data.frame(p_matrix) %>%
  mutate(RNA = rownames(p_matrix)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -RNA,
               names_to = "miRNA",
               values_to = "p_val")
 
cor_result_sig <- r_matrix %>%
  left_join(p_matrix, by = c("RNA", "miRNA")) %>% # joint r and p values
  arrange(p_val) %>% # arrange by p values
  mutate(p_val_adj = p.adjust(p_val, method = "BH")) %>% # adjust p values with BH procedure
  dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(RNA_ENSEMBL = gsub("\\..*", "", RNA)) %>%
  left_join(gene_mapping,  by = c("RNA" = "gene_id")) 
  
cor_result_sig <- cor_result_sig %>%
  dplyr::rename(RNA_symbol = gene_symbol)

write.csv(cor_result_sig, file.path(save_dir, "TCGA_BRCA_mRNA_miRNA_sig_cor.csv"), 
          row.names = F)

# cor_result_sig <- read_csv(file.path(input_data_study_dir, "TCGA_BRCA_mRNA_miRNA_sig_cor.csv"))
  
```

```{r}
nrow(cor_result_sig)
length(unique(cor_result_sig$miRNA))
length(unique(cor_result_sig$RNA_symbol))

cor_result_sig %>% dplyr::filter(coef > 0) %>% nrow()
cor_result_sig %>% dplyr::filter(coef < 0) %>% nrow()
```



```{r}
rna_exp <- rna_analysis %>%
  dplyr::mutate(mean_exp = rowMeans(across(everything())),
                 RNA = row.names(.)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(z_transform_exp = scale(mean_exp)[,1]) %>%
  dplyr::select(RNA, z_transform_exp) %>%
  left_join(cor_result_sig %>% dplyr::select(RNA, RNA_symbol), by = "RNA") %>%
  distinct(RNA, .keep_all = TRUE)

miRNA_exp <- miRNA_analysis %>%
  dplyr::mutate(mean_exp = rowMeans(across(everything())),
                 miRNA = row.names(.)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(z_transform_exp = scale(mean_exp)[,1]) %>%
  dplyr::select(miRNA, z_transform_exp)

cor_exp <- cor_result_sig %>%
  left_join(miRNA_exp, by = "miRNA") %>%
  dplyr::rename(miRNA_exp = z_transform_exp) %>%
  left_join(rna_exp %>% dplyr::select(RNA_symbol, z_transform_exp), by = "RNA_symbol") %>%
  dplyr::rename(rna_exp = z_transform_exp)

```

#### 4.2 miR-TF interactions

\
To check which TFs are targeted by the miRs, we use the Human TF data by [Lambert et al (2018)](http://humantfs.ccbr.utoronto.ca/).
\

```{r}
# Source: http://humantfs.ccbr.utoronto.ca

TF_db <- read.csv(file.path(input_data_common_dir, "HumanTFs.csv"), row.names = 1)

known_TFs <- TF_db %>%
  filter(Is.TF. == 'Yes')
```

```{r}
length(intersect(known_TFs$HGNC.symbol, cor_result_sig$RNA_symbol))
```


```{r}
interactions <- get_multimir(org = "hsa",
                         mirna   = row.names(miRNA_analysis),
                         table   = "validated",
                         summary = TRUE,
                         use.tibble = TRUE)

# # Get miRs that interact with known TFs

interactions_TFs <- as.data.frame(interactions@data %>%
  filter(interactions@data$target_symbol %in% known_TFs$HGNC.symbol))

cat("Out of the", nrow(miRNA_analysis), "miRs,", length(unique(interactions_TFs$mature_mirna_id)),
    "interact with", length(unique(interactions_TFs$target_symbol)), "known TFs.",
    sep = " ")

write.csv(interactions_TFs, file.path(save_dir, "interactions_TFs.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
# interactions_TFs <- read_csv("data_files/publication/TCGA-BRCA/interactions_TFs.csv")
```

#### 4.4 Which miRNAs have correlated genes and intercations with known TFs?

```{r}
# Number of TFs ineracting with each miRNA

miRNA_TF_num <- interactions_TFs %>%
  group_by(miRNA) %>% 
  summarise(num_TFs = n())
```


```{r}
miR_TF <- interactions_TFs %>% 
  dplyr::select(miRNA, target_symbol) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(target_symbol %in% TF_available) %>%
  distinct()

overlap_analysis_data <- cor_result_sig %>%
  group_by(miRNA) %>%
  summarise(
    positively_cor_genes = sum(coef > 0),
    negatively_cor_genes = sum(coef < 0),
    count = n()
  )

overlap_analysis_data <- inner_join(overlap_analysis_data, miR_TF, by = "miRNA") %>%
  group_by(miRNA) %>%
  mutate(count = n()) %>%
  dplyr::rename(TF = target_symbol, num_TF_interactions = count)
```

```{r}
cat("Number of TFs with any Chip-seq data and corrolated with any miRNA in", study, ":", length(unique(overlap_analysis_data$TF)), "\n")
```

```{r}
TF.target.list <- list()
TF_target_file_suffix <- "_hg38_TSS5kb.tsv"

for(TF in TF_available){
  TF.target.file <- read.table(paste(TF_targets_path, "/", TF, TF_target_file_suffix, sep = ""), header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
  names(TF.target.file) <- gsub("\\..*","", names(TF.target.file))
  
  # if any column are breast cancer cell lines
  if (sum(names(TF.target.file) %in% breast_cancer_cell_lines)){
    TF.target.file <- TF.target.file[, c(1, which(names(TF.target.file) %in% breast_cancer_cell_lines))] 
    
    TF.target.file <- TF.target.file %>%
      mutate(consensus = rowMeans(dplyr::select(., -1) != 0)) %>%
      dplyr::filter(consensus>=gene_peaks_in_cell_lines_threshold)
    TF.target.list[[TF]] <- TF.target.file$Target_genes
  }
}

# TF.target.list[["CTCF"]] <- NULL ## remove TF with no target from the list

biological_replicates$TF <- biological_replicates$`Track type`

TF.target.gene.count <- lapply(TF.target.list, length) %>% as.data.frame() %>% t()

TF.target.gene.count <- TF.target.gene.count %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::rename(target.count = V1) %>%
  mutate(TF = rownames(TF.target.gene.count)) %>%
  left_join(biological_replicates, by = ("TF")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(replicate.count = Count) %>%
  dplyr::select(c("TF", "replicate.count", "target.count"))

# check: no linear relationship between TF target count and TF replicate count
ggplot(TF.target.gene.count, aes(x=log2(replicate.count), y=log2(target.count))) +
  geom_point() +
  ggtitle("TF target counts are not correlated with the number of biological replicates") 

spearman.cor <- cor.test(TF.target.gene.count$replicate.count, TF.target.gene.count$target.count, method = "spearman")


TF.target.df <- data.frame(TF = c(), target_genes = c())
TF.target.df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(TF.target.list), function(tf) {data.frame(TF = tf, TF_targets = TF.target.list[[tf]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)})) 
``` 


#### 5. Over-representation analysis (needs to be updated)

For each TF-miRNA pair, calculate 
1) overlap between miRNA-correlated genes and TF targets
2) overlap between the overlapping geneset and miRNA direct targets

```{r}
bg_geneset <- data.frame(TF = "background", 
                         TF_targets = dplyr::filter(gene_mapping, gene_id %in% rownames(rna_analysis))$gene_symbol) 

TERM2GENE <- TF.target.df %>%
  dplyr::filter(TF_targets %in% bg_geneset$TF_targets) %>%
  rbind(bg_geneset)

overlap_analysis_data <- overlap_analysis_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(TF %in% TF.target.df$TF)

mirna.negcor.ora.list <- list()
mirna.poscor.ora.list <- list()

for (mirna in unique(overlap_analysis_data$miRNA)){
  
  mirna_cor_genes_neg <- cor_result_sig %>% 
    dplyr::filter(miRNA == mirna & coef < 0)
  
  mirna_cor_genes_pos <- cor_result_sig %>% 
    dplyr::filter(miRNA == mirna & coef > 0)
  
  # ora with neg.cor genes
  mirna.negcor.ora <- enricher(gene = mirna_cor_genes_neg$RNA_symbol,
                  pvalueCutoff = 1,
                  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                  qvalueCutoff = 1, 
                  universe = bg_geneset$TF_targets,
                  TERM2GENE = TERM2GENE,
                  minGSSize = 0,
                  maxGSSize = (nrow(bg_geneset)-2))
  
  mirna.negcor.ora.list[[mirna]] <- mirna.negcor.ora@result %>%
                                    mutate(miRNA = mirna) %>%
                                    dplyr::select(miRNA, ID, BgRatio, GeneRatio, FoldEnrichment,
                                                  geneID, pvalue) %>%
                                    dplyr::rename(TF_target_BgRatio = BgRatio, 
                                                  negcor_GeneRatio = GeneRatio,
                                                  negcor_FoldEnrichment = FoldEnrichment,
                                                  negcor_overlap_geneID = geneID,
                                                  negcor_ora_pval = pvalue)
  
   # ora with pos.cor genes
   mirna.poscor.ora <- enricher(gene = mirna_cor_genes_pos$RNA_symbol,
                  pvalueCutoff = 1,
                  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                  qvalueCutoff = 1, , universe = bg_geneset$TF_targets,
                  TERM2GENE = TERM2GENE,
                  minGSSize = 0,
                  maxGSSize = (nrow(bg_geneset)-2))
  
  mirna.poscor.ora.list[[mirna]] <-mirna.poscor.ora@result %>%
                                    mutate(miRNA = mirna) %>%
                                    dplyr::select(miRNA, ID, BgRatio, GeneRatio, FoldEnrichment,
                                                  geneID, pvalue) %>%
                                    dplyr::rename(TF_target_BgRatio = BgRatio, 
                                                  poscor_GeneRatio = GeneRatio,
                                                  poscor_FoldEnrichment = FoldEnrichment,
                                                  poscor_overlap_geneID = geneID,
                                                  poscor_ora_pval = pvalue)
}

mirna.negcor.ora.df.combined <- do.call(rbind, mirna.negcor.ora.list)
mirna.poscor.ora.df.combined <- do.call(rbind, mirna.poscor.ora.list)

# match ora to TF-miRNA pairs
overlap_analysis.negcor <- overlap_analysis_data %>%
  left_join(mirna.negcor.ora.df.combined, by = c("miRNA" = "miRNA", "TF" = "ID")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(negcor_ora_pval))

overlap_analysis.poscor <- overlap_analysis_data %>%
  left_join(mirna.poscor.ora.df.combined, by = c("miRNA" = "miRNA", "TF" = "ID"))%>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(poscor_ora_pval))

# multiple hypothesis test adjusment
p.val.df <- data.frame(pval = overlap_analysis.negcor$negcor_ora_pval, group = "negcor") %>%
  rbind(data.frame(pval = overlap_analysis.poscor$poscor_ora_pval, group = "poscor")) %>%
  mutate(adj.pval = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH"))

overlap_analysis.negcor$negcor_ora_pval.adj <- dplyr::filter(p.val.df, group == "negcor")$adj.pval
overlap_analysis.poscor$poscor_ora_pval.adj <- dplyr::filter(p.val.df, group == "poscor")$adj.pval

overlap_analysis.negcor.sig <- overlap_analysis.negcor %>%
  dplyr::filter(negcor_ora_pval.adj < 0.05)

overlap_analysis.poscor.sig <- overlap_analysis.poscor %>%
  dplyr::filter(poscor_ora_pval.adj < 0.05)
```
